_meta.purpose: openspec change migrate-fleet-to-continuous-burns, tasks.md 4.11 — pins the commanded-acceleration validation's rejection DECISION for NaN/+Inf/-Inf/zero/negative inputs cross-target, deliberately WITHOUT recording any value derived from the unguarded expression those inputs would otherwise reach (space.QuantizeArrival's `int64(math.Ceil(flightSeconds*1000))`, which is `int64(math.Ceil(NaN*1000))` when accel is NaN — 0 on arm64, -9223372036854775808 on amd64; this is the exact class pin-system-generation-determinism was created to eliminate for backend/system's keplerPeriodMs). The recorded field here is `wantErr`, a Go sentinel-error identity name — a value that is, by construction, the SAME string on every architecture, because a correct implementation must reject these inputs BEFORE they ever reach the divergent conversion. Recording a value here is therefore safe in a way recording keplerPeriodMs's NaN case was not: this family pins the guard's decision, never the guarded-against arithmetic's result.
_meta.crossTargetSafety: every 'wantErr' value below is a Go identifier name (fleet.ErrAccelBelowFloor), never a numeric result of evaluating the commanded acceleration — see 'purpose' above for why that distinction is what makes cross-target pinning valid here.
